family_reports.body: Between P.D. lack of enforcement of custody orders as part of their job, interference with rights because they think they know what's best, listening to children make a false statement "my mom told me" and passing judgements from a lie rehearsed with a minor, falsification of reports, it's time all of these heartless people are held accountable for their voluntary ignorance and deliberate meddling in places they don't belong!
Having been my son's rock his whole life, to now having to ask for permission to provide basic necessities to him, shows that the wrong parent is repeatedly punished and silenced.

It’s destroyed me as a person. I believed that if I did what was right and tried to be a good stable person for my children everything will be ok. The courts have destroyed my relationship with my kids. I’ve always done everything and sacrificed all my time for my children. I volunteered at their schools and coached their sports. Now I don’t know what to do.

public_comments.comment_text: Biased, one sided, talks in circles, doesn't keep his word, assists when not asked nor warranted, over talks pro-se parties, asks way too much about opinions from ignorant attorneys, and let's them walk all over him making him appear WEAK.
